text:
Riley: hey folks, Riley here (first-week). quick one: I can toggle flags in staging but I don't see Admin > Feature Flags in prod Console. who do I ask to get temporary access for a tiny smoke test?
Anu: welcome! :wave: For prod you need a PRIV ticket — security requires approval + infra grant. What's the flag and timeframe?
Riley: flag=search_vector_v3_rollout, want 2% for ~20m to validate logs. low risk and will revert.
DevSec: FYI we tightened prod flag perms after last years incident. preferential flow: PRIV ticket + link to dashboards + rollback steps. Use the template: PRIV: <desc> | flag: <name> | env: prod | ttl: <time> | monitor: <links> | rollback: <steps>
Riley: ok filing now. my okta email is riley@redwood.ai (staging admin already).
platform-bot: PRIV template: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/privileged-actions#template
Riley: created PRIV-123 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-123 "temp prod toggle search_vector_v3_rollout 2% (20m)". included dashboards and rollback.
Anu: approving PRIV-123. tagging infra for a 30m grant (we usually give small buffer).
infra-bot: initiating grant: `grant-temp-role --user=riley --role=console-admin --env=prod --ttl=00:30 --ticket=PRIV-123 --note="new-hire smoke test"`
infra-bot: grant complete. audit_id=aud-b12f4e. expires in 30m.
Riley: used Console scheduled toggle UI (recommended) to set 2% for 20m. smoke started. thanks!
DevSec: reminder: all privileged actions are auto-logged and will be reviewed. retention 1y.
Riley: tests look good, reverting to 0% now. appreciate the quick approvals.
Anu: adding a line to onboarding: "If you need prod flag writes in week 1, create PRIV ticket on day 0 and attach dashboards."
Riley: saved — that would've saved me 30m earlier. thanks team :heart:
